title: Electrode Stacking Production Chain
content: Electrode stacking is a process step in battery cell assembly. Electrode stacking influences electrode thickness. Electrode thickness affects cell compression. Cell compression influences battery cell quality.

title: Coating Defect Causal Chain
content: Insufficient electrode drying causes residual solvent. Residual solvent causes coating defect formation. Coating defects lead to capacity fade in lithium-ion battery cells.

title: Lithium Plating Root Cause Chain
content: High charging current increases lithium plating risk. Lithium plating degrades graphite electrode material. Degraded graphite electrode material contributes to battery aging.

title: Battery Pack Integration Chain
content: Cell finalization produces validated lithium-ion battery cells. Battery pack integration uses validated lithium-ion battery cells. Battery pack integration produces battery packs for electromobility systems.

title: Thermal Runaway Propagation Chain
content: Internal short circuit causes local heat generation. Local heat generation causes thermal runaway. Thermal runaway can trigger thermal propagation in neighboring cells.

title: PEM Electrolysis Crossover Root Cause
content: Fuel cell membrane degradation increases crossover phenomena in PEM electrolysis. Crossover phenomena reduce PEM electrolyzer efficiency. Electrochemical characterization measures crossover phenomena.
